MortAI is hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to build and improve a marketplace for sports and live-event sponsorships. The role spans marketplace features, search and recommendations, deal infrastructure, measurement products, and integrations across the full stack.
Information Technology & Services
No H1B
U.S. Citizen Only
Hiring Manager
Madison Ortiz
Responsibilities
Ship features across the full stack: frontend, backend, APIs, and data layer
Own features end to end, from data model and technical design through deployment and the metrics that show they worked
Build search, matching, personalization, and AI-powered recommendations that connect brands with the right inventory
Model sponsorship data: properties, assets, packages, pricing, and audience data
Build deal infrastructure: proposals, contracts, payments, and payouts between brands and properties
Help build the measurement product that shows brands what a sponsorship actually delivered
Use AI to move faster, both in how you build and in what ships (LLM-powered listing ingestion, matching, and recommendations)
Partner with designers to turn prototypes into polished production software
Contribute to architecture and technical decisions with the founders
